zh: 一个位置能否接在前一个位置后面，只取决于前一位置选了 A 还是 B，以及它是否不大于当前选的值。
维护两个状态：以 i 结尾且第 i 位选 A[i]（或 B[i]）时，最长合法连续段的长度。
x、y 初始为 1；对 i≥1，若 A[i−1]≤A[i] 则新 x 可取 x+1，若 B[i−1]≤A[i] 则可取 y+1，都不行则为 1；新 y 同理与 B[i] 比较；每步用 max(x, y) 更新答案。
en: Whether a position can follow the previous one depends only on whether the previous position took A or B, and whether that value is not greater than the current choice.
Keep two states: the longest valid contiguous run ending at i when position i takes A[i], and when it takes B[i].

Start with x = y = 1; for i ≥ 1, the new x can be x+1 if A[i−1] ≤ A[i] and y+1 if B[i−1] ≤ A[i], otherwise 1; the new y is the same comparison against B[i]; update the answer with max(x, y) at every step.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain two states: the longest valid contiguous run ending at the current position when it takes A[i], and when it takes B[i]. Check whether each of the previous position's two choices is ≤ the current value; if neither can be extended, restart from the current position.

## Correctness

A valid run reaching the current position can only come from the previous element A[i−1] or B[i−1], which must be no larger than the current value. The two states cover every possibility; taking the longest extendable run is optimal, and otherwise the length is 1.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1).
